# TikTok Shop videos from a product link — scripts that pass Shop rules

**A product link becomes a TikTok Shop script and phone shot list with a real presenter, one number in the demo and a cart CTA.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_06cdbdbc1123.webp" alt="A smiling man in a bright kitchen presses a vegetable chopper and holds the container of diced onion up to the camera, with a $19.99 shop tag." width="480"></p>

Turn a product link into a TikTok Shop video that sells and stays compliant. Writes the script and shot list for a shoppable or affiliate video in TikTok Shop's own styles (personal review, before & after, unboxing, tutorial, problem and fix in one clip), with the product visible from the first frame, one specific number in the demo and a cart CTA, and enforces the 2025–2026 Shop rules that kill reach and accounts: a real person on screen, no AI voice as the presenter, no still-image slideshows (at least 3 s of moving footage), no price or deal that differs from the product page, no exaggerated claims or weight before/after, commercial sounds only, no near-duplicate reposts. Uses AI only for b-roll and product shots. Use when someone makes TikTok Shop videos as a seller or affiliate, asks why Shop videos stall at 200 views or got a violation, or wants Shop content plans. NOT for paid TikTok or Meta ads with AI actors (use ai-ugc-ad-video) or for editing existing footage (use ecommerce-video-edit).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill tiktok-shop-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills tiktok-shop-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
```
